notes.title: Montas Early Access Update #7
notes.notes:
Dear friends,

We are proud to release this long awaited, largest update to Montas yet. This time we have made significant improvements to performance, drastically increasing the framerate for most users. AI has been improved and new added content and re-arranged progression will make it a thrilling experience even for veteran players.

We don't want to spoil anything with a detailed change list so for this update we have decided to remain light on the details.

More options such as control mapping will be coming in future updates.

Thank you for your continued support.

Yours sincerely,
Organic Humans

notes.title: Montas Early Access Update #6
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

In this update, we have improved some features of the AI, and made various tweaks and fixes throughout the game.

Volume Slider added in Options
Save system adjusted
AI Ragdoll introduced with limited integration for now
AI behaviour and attacks adjusted
Dynamic post process now influenced by presence of AI

We hope you enjoy Montas Early Access #6 and stay tuned for more.

Yours Sincerely,
Organic Humans Team

This update adds some more polish and tweaks, along with a new building interior that has been completed and unlocked. The entrance can be found under the Red Cross.

Improvements to AI navigation
Fixed a few issues preventing player progression
New building interior added
Tweaks to art and sound

We hope you enjoy this update and stay tuned for #5

Yours Sincerely,
Organic Humans Team

notes.title: Montas Early Access Update #3 + Happy Holidays!
notes.notes:
Much more content you will find, mmmMMmm! Check it out guys, quite a bit has been done since the last update.

Added notes to find
Improved several AI sequences
Corrected areas that players were getting stuck in
Added additional measures to reduce unnecessary backtracking
Squashed bugs
Added more art

Heaps of content added guys! Keep the feedback coming, we're loving it!

If you would like to suggest content or fixes for the next update you can do so in the Montas Discussion board titled "Friday Night Updates".

Also, a very big happy holidays from both of us at Organic Humans! 

Stay tuned, 

Organic Humans Team

notes.title: Montas Early Access Update #2
notes.notes:
This week, we've got a few minor updates here and there, and also a few fixes too.

Fixed a couple of places that were causing players to get stuck
Fixed a few clipping issues
Improved collision in a number of areas
Improved a few sequences and events

Check out the new content. We've been listening to your feedback, it's been absolutely fantastic, keep it coming! If you would like to suggest content or fixes for the next update you can do so in the Montas Discussion board titled "Friday Night Updates".

We've got more content coming your way in the coming weeks, so keep your eyes peeled on the next few releases :)

Stay tuned, 

Organic Humans Team

notes.title: Montas Early Access Update #1
notes.notes:
Thank you all for supporting Montas on Early Access! We are happy to announce the first of many updates to be released every Friday. 

Improved several scenes & sequences
Added missing collision sounds for a few objects
Fixed missing collision on a few objects
Two new dream levels added on death
Measures added to reduce unnecessary backtracking
Player respawn should no longer conflict with level scripting
Oculus Rift player height fixed (Please don’t use Third Party integration)
Added Invert Mouse, Mouse Sensitivity, Motion Blur, Vertical Sync to Options Menu

We hope you enjoy this first update and be assured we have much more planned to come. If you would like to suggest content or fixes for the next update you can do so in the Montas Discussion on Steam titled “Friday Night Updates”.

Stay tuned,

Organic Humans Team
